target.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Ollama web search had provider-local SecretRef handling for `models.providers.ollama.apiKey`. That duplicated the shared web-search credential contract and made it easier for configured SecretRef behavior to drift from other web-search providers.

## Why This Change Was Made
The Ollama runtime now uses the shared `resolveWebSearchProviderCredential(...)` helper for configured literals, env-backed SecretRefs, unavailable configured refs, and ambient env fallback. Ollama keeps only its provider-specific credential usability filter and stable diagnostic text.

## User Impact
Users who configure an env SecretRef for the Ollama provider key get that resolved key on web-search requests. If the configured SecretRef is missing or non-env, Ollama fails before a network request instead of silently falling through to an unrelated ambient `OLLAMA_API_KEY`. Existing marker-string fallback to `OLLAMA_API_KEY` is preserved.

## Evidence
- `src/agents/tools/web-search-provider-credentials.ts` now supports provider-owned normalization and an unavailable-configured-ref callback while preserving existing fallback behavior for callers that do not opt in.
- `extensions/ollama/src/web-search-provider.ts` no longer imports or calls `resolveSecretInputString`; it delegates the SecretRef/fallback contract to the shared helper.
- `src/agents/tools/web-search-provider-credentials.test.ts` covers env SecretRef success, no ambient fallback for unavailable refs, caller notification for unavailable refs, and marker-string fallback.
- `extensions/ollama/src/web-search-provider.test.ts` covers resolved env SecretRef request auth plus missing/non-env SecretRefs rejecting before `fetchWithSsrFGuard` is called.

## Proof
- `OPENCLAW_VITEST_FS_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=.vitest-cache-ollama-credentials PNPM_CONFIG_MODULES_DIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/workSpace/claw-campaign-llagy/openclaw/node_modules node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/web-search-provider-credentials.test.ts extensions/ollama/src/web-search-provider.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose` (8 helper tests + 19 Ollama tests passed)
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/agents/tools/web-search-provider-credentials.ts src/agents/tools/web-search-provider-credentials.test.ts extensions/ollama/src/web-search-provider.ts extensions/ollama/src/web-search-provider.test.ts docs/.generated/plugin-sdk-api-baseline.sha256`
- `PNPM_CONFIG_MODULES_DIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/workSpace/claw-campaign-llagy/openclaw/node_modules node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/agents/tools/web-search-provider-credentials.ts src/agents/tools/web-search-provider-credentials.test.ts`
- `PNPM_CONFIG_MODULES_DIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/workSpace/claw-campaign-llagy/openclaw/node_modules node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/ollama/src/web-search-provider.ts extensions/ollama/src/web-search-provider.test.ts`
- `PNPM_CONFIG_MODULES_DIR=/media/vdc/0668001470/workSpace/claw-campaign-llagy/openclaw/node_modules node --max-old-space-size=8192 --import tsx scripts/generate-plugin-sdk-api-baseline.ts --check`
